mapper.sql: WHERE keyword COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR title COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR content COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 5
mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, title, content, source FROM JSON_TABLE(#{snapshotJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( id BIGINT PATH '$.id' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, keyword VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.keyword' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, title VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.title' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, content TEXT PATH '$.content' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, source VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.source' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR )) AS frozen_knowledge
